item.title: Self-Hosted IXP Management Platforms: IXP-Manager vs PeeringDB vs JIX (Internet Exchange Guide 2026)
item.description: Internet Exchange Points (IXPs) are the physical infrastructure where networks interconnect to exchange traffic directly, bypassing upstream transit providers and reducing latency and costs. Managing an IXP requires specialized software to handle member onboarding, port provisioning, route server configuration, billing, and peering database management.
